comparison.objective: Transfer and count hex nuts using a desk tally counter; candidate performs connector depinning.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests repetitive pick/place and synchronized counter presses. Candidate tests precision tool insertion, force-controlled release, and bimanual wire manipulation.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires tray count to match the physical tally and nuts to rest in the tray. Candidate requires selective contact removal without damage or disturbing neighboring terminals.
comparison.reason: The objectives and manipulation abilities are clearly unrelated.
